description: This file implements a store for managing remote cluster data in a Mattermost server, including CRUD operations, querying, and updating remote cluster records.

classes.name: sqlRemoteClusterStore
classes.description: A struct implementing the RemoteClusterStore interface for managing remote cluster data in SQL database.

methods.name: newSqlRemoteClusterStore
methods.description: Creates a new instance of sqlRemoteClusterStore with the provided SqlStore.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a RemoteCluster object to the database, handling pluginID collisions.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing RemoteCluster record in the database.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a remote cluster and associated shared channel remotes by setting DeleteAt timestamp.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a RemoteCluster by its RemoteId, optionally including deleted records.

methods.name: GetByPluginID
methods.description: Retrieves a RemoteCluster by its PluginID.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of RemoteClusters based on various filters, with pagination.

methods.name: UpdateTopics
methods.description: Updates the Topics field of a RemoteCluster identified by remoteClusterid.

methods.name: SetLastPingAt
methods.description: Updates the LastPingAt timestamp for a RemoteCluster.

methods.name: UpdateLastGlobalUserSyncAt
methods.description: Updates the LastGlobalUserSyncAt timestamp for a RemoteCluster.
